title: Personal learning navigation verified
summary: Show enrolled or started courses, resume lessons directly, and show saved course progress with clear next actions.

changes.detail: My learning now uses the personal course filter instead of showing the full catalogue.
Direct start/resume buttons, saved-plan progress, learning-journey and lesson-list actions, and due/upcoming review labels.
Clear Arabic review guidance, localized study minutes, and explicit remove-from-plan button text. Unenrolling preserves completed lessons.

validation.name: Interaction checks
validation.detail: Personal catalogue filtering, start/resume routes, generated plan progress, project action, due/upcoming reviews, English/Arabic/French actions, empty state and preservation of progress on unenrollment verified in DOM tests. Six history tests passed.

validation.name: Static checks
validation.detail: Learning app TypeScript and focused ESLint passed.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No physical-device or visual browser QA. No new APK or deployment. Banking warning remains unresolved and remote-control features unchanged.
